Overview

Fremont is a city in CA with a population of 230,504. Bay Area suburb with Tesla, diverse Asian community, and Silicon Valley housing prices. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10a growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year.
